thread:
alex: quick question — I'm updating the /v1/generate routing logic. If we choose a fallback model, do we preserve the request's `response_format` param or do we substitute to the fallback's supported formats? also, what's the definitive priority order for routing hints? (customer routing > region > tier > variant?)

maya: we should try to preserve `response_format` when the fallback supports it. if not supported, runtime should pick the closest supported format and attach a clear warning. priority is: customer routing rules > region hint > capacity tier > model variant.

joel: +1 to the header warning idea. can we add a header like `x-redwood-routing: fallback=<model-id>; reason=<reason>` so clients can detect this and fallback themselves if needed? :eyes: 

sam: fyi, legacy mobile clients send `response_format: \"json_schema_v2\"` which only model-x supports. suggest adding a per-model `supported_response_formats` list in the catalog and have the runtime validate before routing.

infra-bot: Deploy queued: `routing-catalog-update` -> staging (sha: d3f9c1a)

katie: if we change how response_format is coerced, do we consider this an API contract change that needs a migration note? some partners rely on exact schema.

alex: thinking: runtime attempts to preserve `response_format`. if incompatible, runtime will: 1) choose closest supported format, 2) add `x-redwood-routing: fallback=<model-id>; reason=format-incompatible`, and 3) include a `warnings` array in the response body with a short message. PR incoming (#4321). example response snippet: 

```json
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
x-redwood-routing: fallback=model-small-v2; reason=format-incompatible
Content-Type: application/json

{
  \"output\": { \"text\": \"...\" },
  \"warnings\": [\"requested response_format='json_schema_v2' not supported by chosen model, returned closest match\"]
}
```

joel: thanks. can you also add the exact mapping logic to the runtime README so SRE can reason about regressions during rollouts?

sam: reviewed the PR, left a small nit about ordering when multiple region hints exist.

maya: nice. i'll watch the staging deploy and merge once infra is green. :thumbsup:

alex: cool — i'll add a short migration note in docs + a compatibility test that simulates legacy clients. pinging @maya @sam for final review.

joel: ack.
